batch.topic: A customer asks for tofu to replace meat in one serving, while the second serving remains unchanged; no unsupported claim of vegan preparation.
A recipe uses toasted breadcrumbs as a topping, not as a binding ingredient inside the mixture; preserve location and timing.
A diner asks whether a broth contains shellfish before choosing a dish; translate the question without answering or offering a safety guarantee.
A cook rinses salted olives before chopping them and adjusts seasoning only after tasting the mixture; do not add a numeric amount of salt.
